utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus — point out the broken spots and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do, Quinn—just send me any extra needs and I’ll add them right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Dane — that’s a big help. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — that’ll help a lot. If you can, please mention that we still need hands for the porch repairs after the tool sorting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive, mention the start time, and let folks know we still need hands for the porch repairs after the tool sorting.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you still help sort the donated tools, or would you rather jump in with the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — are we definitely doing the repair drive this week? I’d want to confirm the timing before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still tracking tools, tape, screws, and flashlights for the repair drive. If you’ve got anything extra, send it over and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Gus—please bring the tape and flashlight, and if you can find screws tonight, I’ll add those too.

utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — if you hear what they still need for the repair drive, let me know and I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m at the repair drive spot now, and I’ll check the porch first and let you know what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — Sunday at the community center should make it easier for everyone to swing by. I’ll spread the word and keep an ear out for any last-minute fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Tess. If you hear anything else, let me know — I’ll be at the community center Sunday to help with the donated tools and the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the invite and the porch repair timing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll start on the donated tools and then head over to the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the donation hours and whether they want a sign-in list at the door before I do anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Hana — that’d be a big help. If they want a sign-in list, I can bring one over and help set it up at the door.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that would be a big help. If you can confirm the timing and bring whatever tools you find, we’ll be in great shape.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You got it — I’ll confirm the timing and bring any tools I can find to the repair drive table.

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. It’s on Sunday now at the community center, and I could use a hand setting up when you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center works, but I’ll need a clear time so I can plan the trip. What time should I come help set up?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you come by around 1 PM? I’d really appreciate the help setting up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll check the rear gate latch and let you know, and I’ll keep everyone updated about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and repeat the start time again tomorrow so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping it top of mind. I’ll report back on the latch and keep the Sunday community center details circulating.
